LanguageData.UN029_MixedBad: Gender separation: violation — −10 total per assessment (every 3 days).
LanguageData.UN029_Active: A UN supply order is already active.
LanguageData.UN029_Cooldown: New orders are available 3 days after the previous acceptance.
LanguageData.UN029_Cancel: Cancel order (delivered supplies are not returned)
LanguageData.UN029_Terms:
Deliver {0} × {1} within 10 days. Reward: +{2} UN goodwill (capped at +100).

Contact the UN with a colonist using a communications console. Reopen this order tier and select “Hand over available supplies now”. Reachable, non-forbidden goods on this home map are consumed immediately. Partial deliveries are saved. Nothing is handed over automatically.

Only one UN order at a time; a new order can be accepted after 3 days. Cancellation or expiry does not refund supplies and does not penalize goodwill. Delivery is blocked while UN goodwill is negative.
LanguageData.UN029_RecoveryBlocked: A negative condition was observed this period: no recovery at the next assessment. Penalties depend on conditions then and existing grace periods.
LanguageData.UN029_RecoveryPossible: No violation recorded so far: three clean days recover +10 up to 0 only. New violations can still block this.
LanguageData.UN029_PrisonRules:
PRISON PENALTIES

Mixed-gender cells: −10 total every 3 days, regardless of prisoners or cells.

No suitable prisoner bed, sleeping spot only or outdoors: −2 per prisoner every 3 days.

Food below 25%: −5 per prisoner every 3 days.

Tracked missing body part without replacement: −5 per part, capped at −20 per prisoner every 3 days.

Currently tendable, untreated disease or other non-injury condition: −5 per prisoner every 3 days, not per disease.

Currently tendable, untreated injury: −3 per prisoner every 3 days, not per injury.

Colonist operation on a prisoner reported as unlawful by the game: −15 immediately per reported violation.
LanguageData.UN029_RecoveryRules:
RECOVERY AND STARTING GOODWILL

Three days without a recorded negative condition or acute violation: +10, up to 0 only.

No prisoners and no recorded violation: also +10 recovery up to 0.

At 0 or above: good prison care awards no additional points.

New game: random starting goodwill 0 to +10 if the initial relationship is neutral at 0.

Existing save: existing goodwill is preserved.
LanguageData.UN029_AccessRules:
ACCESS THRESHOLDS

0: ordinary UN orders.
+50: advanced UN orders.
+75 and allied: reinforcements if all other deployment conditions are met.
+100 for 15 uninterrupted days: UN equipment manufacturing unlocks.
−50 or worse: UN military interventions begin; normally every 3 days at −100.
